author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This year’s Big Game just got a lot more interesting!
🏈 Want $50K? Build your own Big Game app with Base44! https://base44.com/biggame 

Base44 is hosting an open no-code app challenge with $50,000 in prizes, and the best part? Anyone can enter — no coding required.

With Base44, you can build a fully functional app using nothing more than a written prompt. If you can describe your idea, Base44 can build it. And watch until the end to see what Kevin suggests you use the prize money for!

In this video, I'll break down:
 - How the Base44 Big Game Challenge works
 - How to build an app without writing a single line of code
 - Real app examples you can create in minutes
 - How to publish, customize, and share your app
 - Tips to increase your chances of winning the $50,000 prize

🏆 How the Base44 Big Game Challenge Works
 - Contest deadline: February 10
 - Winners announced: February 12
 - Prize pool: $50,000
 - Who can enter: Anyone
 - Skill level: Beginner-friendly (no coding needed)
title: Build an App. Win $50K | The Base44 Big Game Challenge
